dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with a slight central dip at the midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 30 percent of the vertical span of the visible upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-red environmental staining or fur discoloration on the lower dorsal and lumbar regions.
